children: Toyota Motor Corp. Sponsored ADR (TSE:7203) is accelerating a software-defined, Arene-led shift—deploying Arene across ~50 models (10M vehicles/yr by 2030) and converting its full lineup—while recalling 30,978 U.S. cars for a powertrain issue and expanding hydrogen and local manufacturing initiatives.
: Toyota Motor Corp. (7203) recalled 30,978 U.S. vehicles over a potential powertrain shutdown that could cause loss of drive power, per NHTSA; recall covers U.S.-distributed models.
: Toyota (7203) will roll out its Arene software across ~50 models, aiming for ~10 million new vehicles annually by 2030. Arene debuts on the 2025 RAV4; Toyota plans partner licensing by 2035.
: Toyota Motor Corp. Sponsored ADR (7203) plans to convert its full 50-model lineup to software-defined vehicles by 2030, shifting vehicle features and functions to software-driven architectures.
: Toyota Motor Corp. Sponsored ADR (7203) won Thai board approval for a 1.49 billion baht (~$44.5M) investment to build hydrogen-powered pickup trucks in Thailand.
: Toyota Motor Corp. (7203) and Isuzu launched the new-generation Toyota Sora hydrogen bus: 10.54 m, up to 70 passengers, 113 kW fuel cell, 220 kW motors, >300 km range, 20% lower hydrogen capacity.

: Toyota Motor Corp. Sponsored ADR (7203) can produce in France using local subcontractors near its plant, indicating active domestic manufacturing and local supplier usage despite supply-chain shifts.
